svg.text: Convolutions run along the RANK axis only, with weights shared across all four suits.
Ranks are ordered, suits are not: a kernel crossing suits would assert an adjacency the rules lack.
input 14 planes x 4 suits x 13 ranks
mean over suits is symmetric, so
phase · tricks won · match points · seat
projected and added to every cell
every card keeps its own score
pooling discards which suit is which,
so play defers trump calls to greedy
The search scores every legal action in sampled worlds; the network orders the candidates and eliminates only what the evidence rules out.
